subject: Cohesive under-pool book about speaking up, with unique pictures
question: Owner editorial and artwork correction to the current under-pool draft.
decision: Owner: "Proofread and critically analyze from a plotting perspective. You are an award winning child's author who is using this as a platform to teach important life lessons about letting your voice be heard. Re-write book for clear plotting. The initial draft have a visually appealing world, but there's lacking narrative cohesion. All pictures must be unique, no crops or resizes, any nonsense". This commissions a full 32-page story rewrite and unique new drawings for this newly commissioned under-pool book. Prior editions, protected sources, identities and separate source-preserving adaptation remain unchanged. Publication, art/story acceptance, runtime integration and release are not implied.
